text:
Ravi: Heads-up 0-hour check for the Spot Awards pop-up at the quarterly retreat. need final confirmations on budget, approvals, and cross-office fulfillment.
June: Im running the AM shift. pls confirm petty cash amount and whether we need receipts for $25 awards.
finance-bot: Policy reminder: awards <= $50 require receipt logging; >$50 need manager + director approval and payroll tagging. See comp policy link.
Nia: For remote employees, can we send a digital voucher or do we ship a swag pack? some APAC folks prefer local vouchers.
Marta: procurement note: bulk local vouchers are available but need 5 business days lead. for same-day, e-gift cards (USD) are fastest but not always redeemable.
Taylor: Inventory at the office: 80 enamel pins, 60 stickers, 40 tees (S/M/L), 100 printed nomination slips.
Ravi: Good. volunteer schedule drafted: 911:30 June + Taylor; 11:303:30 Ravi + Nia; 13:305:30 Marta + floater.
June: Will bring a cash float of $150 (lockbox) and a clipboard for offline logging.
Nia: I'll prep a spreadsheet template for batch entry and a column for country code so finance-bot can handle tax flags.
Marta: I'll make a physical "Manager Approval" sticker sheet for anything over $75.
Ravi: Approvals flow: manager initials on sticker, director sign for >$150. volunteers should not distribute >$150 without approval sticker.
Taylor: Accessibility: include a privacy envelope option and a small sign "Quiet Recognition" for folks who want no stage callout.
June: Can comms make two small A3 signs: "Recognition Kiosk" and "Quiet Recognition"? I'll ping them now.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: log event supplies to inventory system by EOD Thurs or items will be marked missing.
Ravi: Post-event process: 1) volunteers upload receipts and signed approval sheet to /finance/awards by Tuesday, 2) people-ops will reconcile and close ticket.
Marta: Quick tax callout: if a recipient is in Ireland or Germany and award >$100, payroll needs country-specific reporting. tag country in sheet.
Nia: I'll add a dropdown for country in the offline sheet and a required field for manager name.
June: Can we have pre-printed sealed envelopes for surprise awards? safer than open handing.
Ravi: Yes. Marta please bring envelopes; Taylor to bring a small labeler to mark envelopes with recipient name.
Taylor: Also bringing a card-stock FAQ card with short answers: "How long will e-gift take?" "What is a spot award?"
finance-bot: Note: reimbursements must include original receipt image. Mobile photo is fine.
Ravi: Final action items: June: lockbox + morning shift; Nia: offline sheet + country dropdown; Marta: envelopes + approval stickers; Taylor: signs + labeler + FAQ. I'll DM comms for signage and post volunteer sign-up in #all-hands.
peopleops-bot: Volunteer roster locked 2026-04-02T17:00:00Z.
June: All good here, thanks. :tada:
Ravi: Thanks team, will close the loop after the event.
